_doc: 08 SL-3 v1 bark table (I-20): BarkDef[], one entry per key. Singleton-style file: the table rows of 08 SL-3 rule 3 (Derived from, Scope, Prio, Release) map to source, scope, priority and status; cooldown_s is the 08 SL-3 rule 4 per-entity 20 s key cooldown. Strings are not stored here: they live in the locale CSV domain `barks` as barks.<key>.<variant> (R0 C2-33, 06 s11). Rate limits are the 08 SL-3 rule 4 values.
